blocks.text: Exercise mein kitab ke 10 multiple choice, 8 short aur 5 long questions hain (neeche Roman Urdu mein). Har sawal ka jawab us topic ke Roman Urdu lesson mein self-check ki shakal mein hai; yahan MCQs ke jawab ek jagah jama hain.

items: Digital literacy ka key component kaunsa hai? (a) shairi likhna (b) khet-bari ke tareeqe samajhna (c) digital tools ko achhi tarah istemal karna (d) public speaking ki mashq
Search results se koi lafz nikalne ke liye kaunsa Boolean operator? (a) OR (b) AND (c) NOT (d) NEITHER

Online sources ko parakhne ke liye kaunsi maharat zaroori hai? (a) source ki saakh ka andaza lagana (b) content banane wale ka naam jaanna (c) check karna ke content kisi bharose wale idare (trusted entity) ka hai (d) content kai baar parhna

Research question banate waqt specific hona kyun zaroori hai? (a) taake bohat se topics aa jayein (b) taake wazeh ho ke kya jaanna hai aur mubham sawal na hon (c) taake zyada se zyada maloomat shamil ho (d) taake research zyada aam (generalizable) ho
Article ke “peer-reviewed” hone ka matlab? (a) ek hi expert ne edit kiya (b) magazine mein chhapa (c) usi field ke doosre experts ne check kiya (d) online muft milta hai
Online libraries ka aham maqsad? (a) tafreeh (entertainment) dena (b) mukhtalif academic resources dena (c) social media ko barhana (d) digital kitabein bechna

Ethical research ka zaroori hissa? (a) participants ki privacy ki parwah kiye baghair zyada data jama karna (b) plagiarism se bachna aur sahi credit dena (c) sirf achhe (positive) nataij chhapna (d) research aham ho to ijazat nazar-andaz karna
Nataij ko sachai aur shaffafiyat se report karna kis usool mein aata hai? (a) Confidentiality (b) Integrity (c) Informed Consent (d) Avoiding Bias
Kaunsi intellectual property ki qisam NAHI hai? (a) Patents (b) Trademarks (c) Copyrights (d) Physical Properties
Company trade secret kaise bachaye? (a) IPO mein register kar ke (b) trademark ki darkhwast de kar (c) maloomat raaz rakh kar aur legal agreements se (d) scientific journal mein chhap kar

Intellectual property ki mukhtalif qismein misalon ke saath bataiye, aur har qisam kis tarah ki takhleeq ki hifazat karti hai. (Types of Intellectual Property)

blocks.prompt: Intellectual property ki qismein misalon ke saath bataiye, aur har qisam mukhtalif takhleeqat ki hifazat kaise karti hai? (Long question 5)
blocks.explanation: Patent invention (naya product ya process) ki hifazat karta hai; misal: Pakistani engineer ka behtar solar panel, jise kuch saal tak sirf wohi bana aur bech sakta hai. Trademark nishan, logo ya naam ki hifazat karta hai jo brand ki pehchan hai; misal: National Foods ka logo. Copyright adabi aur fanni kaam (kitab, music, film, software) ki hifazat karta hai; misal: Pakistani musannif ka novel, jise sirf woh chhap, bech ya film mein badal sakta hai. Industrial design product ki shakal aur khoobsurti ki hifazat karta hai; misal: Karachi ke designer ki mineral water bottle. Trade secret raaz wali karobari maloomat ki hifazat karta hai jab tak woh raaz rahe; misal: kitab ke mutabiq Pakola ki recipe.
